items.why: Profit-taking deepened after the run to record highs, with shares breaking below $620 support. ARK trimmed its stake and Microsoft unveiled its own Maia 300 AI chip, sharpening competition fears.
Riding renewed AI optimism. Wells Fargo lifted its target to $1,000 on October 6 and investors kept bidding up the Muse agent story after Meta Connect.
Supply fears after Houthi drone and missile strikes on Riyadh airport and fresh Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy sites, pushing Brent above $105.
Chip names slid as reports put OpenAI annualized revenue near $50B, well under the $68B figure markets had expected, raising doubts about AI capex durability.

market_note: Bond market closed for Columbus Day. Bank earnings kick off Tuesday and CPI lands Wednesday, which sets the Fed tone.
summary: Split market to start the week. Energy and the Dow rose on a spike in oil prices, while chip stocks dragged the Nasdaq lower and the S&P hovered near record highs.
